name: Micronesia (Federated States of)
summary: The Federated States of Micronesia taxes wages and salaries (6% on the first USD 11,000, 10% above) and the gross revenue of businesses (3% above USD 10,000). There is no tax on an individual's investment income or capital gains outside a business, and no inheritance, gift or wealth tax was found. Based on the 2014 FSM Code; later amendments and state-level taxes were not checked.

regimes.name: Ordinary residence
regimes.description: Wage and salary tax plus a gross revenue tax on businesses; no tax on private investment income.
regimes.eligibility: No tax residence test is relevant for investment income.

capital_gains.summary: No capital gains tax: national taxes are the wage and salary tax (54 FSMC 121) and the gross revenue tax on businesses (54 FSMC 141).

sources.title: FSM Code (2014 Annotated) Title 54 Taxation and Customs

capital_gains.rate_basis: 54 FSMC 112(5): 'gross revenue' is receipts of a trade or business (including returns on the capital of the business); a non-business investor's gains are outside both taxes.
capital_gains.professional_trader: A business dealing in securities or property would pay 3% gross revenue tax on its receipts (above USD 10,000).
open_questions: Amendments after the 2014 Code and any state taxes were not checked.

dividends.summary: No tax on dividends received by an individual outside a business.

sources.title: FSM Code (2014 Annotated) Title 54 Taxation and Customs

dividends.rate_basis: 54 FSMC 121 (wages) and 141 (business gross revenue) are the national income taxes; dividends of a private investor are in neither base.
dividends.treaty_network: No comprehensive treaties found (not verified). US dividends bear 30% US WHT.

wealth_tax.summary: No net wealth tax and no recurring levy on financial assets.

sources.title: FSM Code (2014 Annotated) Title 54 Taxation and Customs

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax in Title 54 (Taxation and Customs).

sources.title: FSM Code (2014 Annotated) Title 54 Taxation and Customs

open_questions: State codes (Pohnpei, Chuuk, Yap, Kosrae) not checked. Non-citizens cannot own land (constitution; not verified).

residency.tax_residency_test: No tax on investment income, so no relevant residence test.

sources.title: FSM Code (2014 Annotated) Title 54 Taxation and Customs

corporate.summary: No corporate income tax at national level in Title 54: businesses pay gross revenue tax of USD 80 on the first USD 10,000 and 3% above (54 FSMC 141, as summarised in the Code text read).

sources.title: FSM Code (2014 Annotated) Title 54 Taxation and Customs

us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain subject to US federal income, estate and gift tax on worldwide income and assets wherever they live; the app adds the federal layer. Where local tax on portfolio income is nil there is nothing to credit against US tax.
open_questions: Tax reform proposals (e.g. a unified revenue authority and net profits tax) have been discussed for years; nothing in force found.
